caveats: Only 3 of 10 are confirmed operating (East Avenue, Rachel Boutique, NAYAB Couture). Three are closed: Google marks Duchess Florals and AC Vintage Clothing permanently closed, and Cha Cha Gifts is temporarily closed with reviews reporting a June 2026 closure and a dead website. Four could not be found on Google Maps at all.
Google Maps was read through the public, logged-out 'limited view', which sometimes hides review counts. Counts marked 'per Loc8NearMe/Birdeye mirror' come from those aggregators mirroring Google.
'Not found' statuses mean no Google Business Profile, no website and no published hours could be located; a phone-only or unlisted shop could still be trading, which is a limit of web-only research.
No business in this batch has schema.org markup or a booking platform, so agent-readiness scores are structurally low rather than merely neglected.
Priority order for a deeper audit: East Avenue first (real revenue, live site, claimed profile), then NAYAB Couture (tailoring volume), then Rachel Boutique (cheapest fix, thinnest evidence).
data_gaps: No phone verification of any business was possible (read-only research), so hours and trading status rest on Google and directory data.
Review counts for NAYAB Couture, Rachel Boutique and AC Vintage Clothing were not exposed in Google's limited profile view.
Carpet Plus Inc., Always New For You, Anything ZYX1 and Alternative Gifts have no Google Business Profile; could not determine whether they closed or were simply never listed.
East Avenue: no product-level pages were opened, so Product structured data beyond the home page was not checked.
Cha Cha Gifts: the former website could not be opened (SSL handshake failure), so its last live content and copyright year are unknown.
